name: Delayed Function
description: This algorithm generates a variety of one-shot functions after a delay, when triggered. The logic of each channel is as follows: When triggered, it immediately jumps to its idle voltage, if not already there. It stays at that voltage for the duration set by the Delay parameter. It then executes the function, for the duration set by the Time parameter, if relevant (for example, the Step function has no duration). Depending on the function, it then remains at the active or idle voltage until triggered again. The available functions are: Pulse - A simple rectangular pulse of the specified duration. Step - A step – the output goes from idle to active after the delay, and remains at the active level until retriggered. Ramp - A rising ramp of the specified duration. Stays at the active level after the ramp is complete. Sawtooth - A rising ramp of the specified duration, which jumps back to the idle level when complete.
use_cases: Generating one-shot functions after a delay when triggered
Creating timed pulses, steps, ramps, and sawtooths
gui_description: The display shows, for each channel, from top to bottom: The remaining time of the delay, once triggered. The remaining time of the function. The output function as a bar graph.

parameters.name: Delay multiplier
parameters.description: Sets a multiplier for the delay time, one of x1, x2, x5, x10, x20, x50, or x100.

parameters.name: Time multiplier
parameters.description: Sets a multiplier for the function duration, one of x1, x2, x5, x10, x20, x50, or x100.

parameters.description: The standard Add/Replace mode selector as described above.

parameters.description: The MIDI channel on which notes can trigger the function generator.

parameters.name: I2C channel
parameters.description: The I2C channel on which notes can trigger the function generator.
